summary.en: motionEye is a web front end for the motion daemon. ARMv6 and ARMv7 32-bit are install targets and need extra build dependencies. Heavy on one core is an opinion.
summary.zh-CN: motionEye 是 motion 守护进程的网页前端。ARMv6 和 ARMv7 32 位可以安装，但需要额外的编译依赖。说它吃满一个核是看法，不是规格。

zero_w_note.en: The README lists ARMv6/ARMv7 32-bit as an install target that needs extra build deps (python3-dev, gcc, libjpeg, libcurl, libssl, libffi). https://github.com/motioneye-project/motioneye . Heavy on one core [Opinion].
zero_w_note.zh-CN: README 把 ARMv6/ARMv7 32 位列为安装目标，需要额外的编译依赖（python3-dev、gcc、libjpeg、libcurl、libssl、libffi）。吃满一个核是看法。

text.en: The camera is flagged as needing the Zero cable. The bill adds that cable even though nobody typed it into the parts list. The camera body is not drawn.
text.zh-CN: 相机被标成需要 Zero 排线。账单会加上这根线，即使零件清单里没人写它。相机本体不绘制。

title.en: The connector is the small one

text.en: The Zero W CSI port is 22 pins at 0.5 mm pitch and 11.5 mm wide. The product page says the cable in the camera box does not fit. Use the Standard–Mini cable.
text.zh-CN: Zero W 的 CSI 是 22 针、0.5 mm 间距、宽 11.5 mm。产品页写明相机盒子里的线插不进去。用 Standard–Mini 排线。

text.en: Start from the project README and the install notes it links. If those notes require a newer architecture, stop. A 64-bit image will not boot on this board.
text.zh-CN: 从项目 README 和它链接的安装说明开始。如果那些说明要求更新的架构，就停。64 位镜像在这块板上起不来。
